blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY, Lanao del Norte, Philippines —More than nine years after militants aligned with the global terror network Islamic State (IS) desecrated the St. Mary’s Cathedral (Cathedral of Maria Auxiliadora), the Prelature of St. Mary in Marawi City is consecrating a new one, albeit temporarily, to celebrate the church’s 50th founding anniversary on Friday.
